items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: I heard a guy say one time, I don’t know what his name is, I always mix him up with, he played, in Malcolm X he played Elijah Muhammad.

ctx.x: You’re — a lot of great musicians came out of Detroit.

Oh boy, it was quite an environment. It was wonderful. It was sharing. You know, they said, I heard a guy say one time, I don’t know what his name is, I always mix him up with, he played, in Malcolm X he played Elijah Muhammad. I could never — he teaches out at Howard University. I can’t think of his name though. I always mix him up with the other famous black actor that gets all the Oscars and everything. You know who I’m talking about. He was in “Driving Miss Daisy?”
